cv_overlay.headline: DIRECTOR OF ENERGY & SUSTAINABILITY | DECARBONIZATION | PUBLIC-SECTOR & REGULATORY LEADERSHIP
cv_overlay.profile: Director-level sustainability and external affairs leader with 12+ years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. Current leadership at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, spans ESG, climate and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, cross-functional program coordination, executive communications and stakeholder governance. Brings direct exposure to a major industrial renewable-energy platform, carbon-data assurance, environmental governance and public-sector coordination, supported by an MBA and international executive development in sustainable mineral-resource management.
relevance: Energy and decarbonization: stakeholder governance and external alignment around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage across mine and port operations, supporting industrial decarbonization and energy-transition objectives.

Climate data and accountability: coordinated a carbon-data proof of concept covering a 52.6 million-litre fuel baseline, 34 entities, 408 monthly entries and 592 equipment IDs, strengthening source ownership, traceability and review readiness.

Public-sector leadership: senior working relationships with ministries, regulators and public institutions across energy, environment, mining, labour, standards, taxation, trade and investment, translating institutional requirements into executive actions and documented follow-through.

Program governance: aligns Operations, HSE, Environment, Legal, Finance, HR, Procurement, Security, Aviation and technical teams on high-priority programs, regulatory commitments and evidence-based delivery.

Maryland policy readiness: prepared for a leadership mandate centered on statewide energy management, facility decarbonization, fleet electrification, sustainable purchasing and implementation of Maryland climate goals, including the Climate Solutions Now Act framework.
impact: Progressed through six successive AGM appointments since 2020 into Director-level leadership, with expanding responsibility across government relations, corporate affairs, compliance, ESG and social responsibility.

Support governance and external positioning around AGM's approximately 46-50 MWp solar and 80+ MWh battery-storage platform, connecting sustainability priorities with institutional and operating stakeholders.
Coordinated a 2026 carbon-data proof of concept using physical operating data across a 52.6 million-litre fuel baseline, 34 entities, 408 monthly entries and 592 equipment IDs.

Lead senior engagement with public authorities and regulators while coordinating inspections, submissions, approvals, commitments and corrective actions across a large, asset-intensive operating environment.
Prepare executive briefs, regulator-facing submissions, strategic correspondence and decision materials for senior management and external stakeholders.

messages.subject: Director of Energy
messages.body:
Dear DGS Hiring Committee,

Please accept my application for the Director of Energy and Sustainability, Program Manager Senior II position, Recruitment #26-005483-0034.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership portfolio sits at the intersection of sustainability, climate action, government and regulatory relations, executive coordination and large-scale industrial operations. I have progressed through six successive appointments at AGM since 2020, with responsibility expanding across corporate affairs, compliance, ESG and social responsibility.

My experience is especially relevant to the Office of Energy and Sustainability mandate. I support stakeholder governance and external alignment around an industrial renewable-energy platform of approximately 46-50 MWp of solar generation and more than 80 MWh of battery storage. I also coordinated a carbon-data proof of concept covering a 52.6 million-litre fuel baseline, 34 entities, 408 monthly entries and 592 equipment IDs, with emphasis on source ownership, traceability and defensible evidence. Across my current mandate, I align Operations, HSE, Environment, Legal, Finance, HR, Procurement, Security, Aviation and technical teams on regulatory commitments, strategic programs and executive priorities.

I have studied Maryland's climate and energy-management framework, including the Climate Solutions Now Act and the Office of Energy and Sustainability's whole-of-government responsibilities across energy management, facility decarbonization, fleet electrification, sustainable purchasing and cross-agency implementation. While my career has developed in multinational industry rather than a U.S. state agency, I bring an operator's perspective on converting climate commitments, regulatory expectations and complex stakeholder requirements into accountable execution.

My MBA, BSc in Business Administration, international executive development in sustainable mineral-resource management, and current director-level experience provide a strong foundation for this mandate. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my leadership approach and international operating experience would support DGS and Maryland's energy and climate objectives.

My tailored executive resume is attached for your consideration. Thank you for reviewing my application.

Respectfully,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
